en.hubeali: And from him, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘What are youasws saying regarding a woman who was ignorant (of the fact) that she should be pelting the Jamarah, until she went to Makkah?’ Heasws said: ‘So let her return and let her pelt the Jamarah, just as she would have pelted; and (for) the men, it is like that (as well)’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who is ignorant of throwing pebbles until she leaves Makkah. He (the Imam) said, ‘She must return to throw pebbles as she was required to throw and the same rule applies to man.’”
